title: TSDProxy internal authentication-token disclosure
summary: The upstream TSDProxy advisory describes forwarding an internal proxy authentication token to backend services, potentially exposing management privileges when the affected identity-header behavior is enabled. The disclosure identifies the audit as work by an AI-assisted research agent.
ai_role: The upstream advisory attributes the audit to the sechub.dev AI-assisted research agent; this is source attribution, not independent reconstruction of model steps.
classification_note: The reviewed original source documents public disclosure; unknown zero-day status is not inferred.
remediation_note: The advisory lists a corrected Go pseudo-version 1.4.4-0.20260603142855-434819b4421e. A documented correction does not establish deployment or current safety.
